text: How big is our Sun? Let me show you.
The Sun is about one point four million kilometers wide.
That is one hundred and nine Earths in a row.
To fill it, you need about one point three million Earths.
Its light takes eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach us.
It has ninety-nine point eight percent of the mass in our Solar System.
But next to other stars, it is just a medium size star.
